style.backgroundSystem: full-bleed flat printed square-ruled colour blocks alternating amber #F6B23C and cobalt #2F6BE8, ink-outlined geometric confetti and one notched lightning ribbon band; never a photographed surface
style.iconSystem: thick ink #1C1F26 outlined flat pictograms only: check discs, striped arcs, pills, dot tabs and a loop arrow, filled with lemon #F4E515, drawn on the colour block; no 3D icons, no gradient badges
style.lightingSystem: even flat graphic field light on the printed background; the cleanly cut-out product gets one soft frontal key, one thin specular line on the pump only, and a single hard offset cobalt #2F6BE8 printed shadow shape; no gradients, no softbox falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pop-print poster visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of printed amber #F6B23C, printed cobalt #2F6BE8, lemon insert #F4E515 and ink outline #1C1F26; warm high-saturation graphic treatment; squared modern sans-serif with one small-caps latin rail under each headline; background system of full-bleed flat printed square-ruled colour blocks alternating amber and cobalt, carrying ink-outlined geometric confetti (striped arc, pill, dot) and one notched lightning ribbon band; the product is a clean photographic cut-out placed inside a flat 2D printed field, lit by one soft frontal key with a single thin specular line and one hard offset cobalt shadow shape; surfaces are printed paperboard only, never a counter, tile, stone, wood or water; icon system of thick single-weight ink outlined flat pictograms filled with lemon #F4E515, no 3D icons and no gradient badges; every proof slot stays an empty rail, disc or card; no colour palette changes outside #F6B23C, #2F6BE8, #F4E515 and #1C1F26, no photographic backgrounds, no soft gradient glow, no realistic long shadows, no mixed fonts, no filled-in claims or codes.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F6B23C, #2F6BE8, #F4E515 and #1C1F26
no photographic backgrounds, studio sweeps, rooms or real tabletops
no soft gradient glows, no realistic long shadows, no drop blur
no mixed fonts and no script or handwritten lettering
no filled-in claims, numbers, certificates or codes in any proof slot
style.presentationRules: product stays photographic and cleanly cut out at stable upright scale inside a flat 2D printed field; label face left to the reference artwork, no drawn lettering; every proof slot stays an empty rail, disc or card
style.surfaceSystem: printed paperboard fields only, amber #F6B23C and cobalt #2F6BE8 with square ruling; no counter, no tile, no stone, no wood, no water
